[Gentlemen](/organisation/248)
I am much obliged for the [draft for £10](/topic/172) received this morning as well as the copies of the [Story of the Christians and Moors](/book/126), which I am very glad to have in this cheap form. I am much obliged for your liberality in the matter, and
remain &c

C M Yonge
